title: PredicationCell
description: The predication cell: a subject term, a predicate carrying a Claim's mark, and an object term (predicating/predication.mts `Cell`), holding the charge assigned to it (predicating/positing/bilattice-charge.mts `ChargeCarrier`) — the ruled bundled form, matching the pre-Lean carriers PyPredCalc (s, p, o, v), PyFARS, and FARS. The charge is never optional: it defaults to the absurd bottom charge before evidence arrives.

predicate.title: Predicate
predicate.description: An object of the predicate category, carrying a Claim's mark (predicating/predication.mts `Predicate`).
